item.title: Dragon Ball Z Officially Returns to Its Original Android Era
item.description: The beloved Android saga from Dragon Ball Z returns through newly shared official artwork, marking a nostalgic moment for fans of this pivotal story arc.

item.title: 7 Hyped-Up 2010s Anime Everyone Already Forgot About
item.description: Several anime series that gained attention during the 2010s have since faded from public awareness, including titles like Level E and Samurai Flamenco.

item.title: Yen Press Licenses [Oshi No Ko] Étude for Two, Bungo Stray Dogs: The Untold Origins of the Detective Agency, More Manga/
item.description: Yen Press has acquired licenses for multiple manga and light novel series, including titles related to the anime adaptations Oshi No Ko and Bungo Stray Dogs, alongside several other works.

item.title: These 4 Manga Series Are Taking Over—Which One Wins? - Woman's World
item.description: Four manga series are competing for prominence in the current market. The article examines which titles are gaining the most traction.

item.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Officially Adds Alternate Endings for Shibuya Incident in New Update - FandomWire
item.description: Jujutsu Kaisen has introduced multiple alternative storyline conclusions for the Shibuya arc through a recent update to the franchise.

item.title: Chiruran Manga Gets New Stage Play by All-Female Troupe O'Clock Kumamoto Revue
item.description: The Chiruran manga will receive a stage play adaptation from an all-female theater troupe, with the original creator penning the script for its early summer 2027 debut.

item.title: 'Tougen Anki: Nikko Kegon no Taki-hen' Unveils Additional Cast
item.description: The official website for the Tougen Anki: Nikko Kegon Falls Arc anime announced additional cast members on Saturday. The second season's first part began airing in early October.

item.title: Overgeared Volumes 4-6 K-Comic Review
item.description: Anime News Network reviews volumes 4-6 of the K-Comic series Overgeared, examining the protagonist's characterization and whether his behavior enhances or detracts from the narrative.

item.title: Manga 'Haite Kudasai, Takamine-san' Ends Serialization
item.description: Author Yuuichi Hiiragi's manga series will conclude its nearly eight-year serialization in the February issue of Gangan Joker magazine.

item.title: Duel Masters LOST Anime Gets 5th Part
item.description: The fifth installment of the Duel Masters LOST manga series launched on September 17, continuing the card game franchise's story.

item.title: BanG Dream! Yume∞Mita Series Confirms New Anime in Production
item.description: A new anime adaptation is in development for the Mugendai Mewtype band within the BanG Dream! franchise, following the July premiere of a TV series based on the project.

item.title: Supporting Cast for 'Kaketa Tsuki no Mercedes' Announced
item.description: The television anime adaptation of Firehead's light novel has announced its supporting cast members through the official website.

item.title: FX Fighter Kurumi-chan ‒ Episode 8
item.description: In Episode 8 of FX Fighter Kurumi-chan, a protege follows her mentor's questionable financial practices, mirroring Kurumi's methods despite the latter's reluctance to accept responsibility.

item.title: 'BanG Dream! Yume∞Mita' New Anime in Production
item.description: A new BanG Dream! television anime titled Yume∞Mita is in production by Nichicaline, set to premiere in Summer 2026 with 13 episodes. Crunchyroll will stream the series with English subtitles.

item.title: Manga 'Jimoto no Ijimekko-tachi ni Shikaeshi Shiyou to Shitara, Betsu no Tatakai ga Hajimatta.' Gets TV Anime
item.description: An official website launched for a television anime adaptation of Kengo Matsumoto's manga about seeking revenge on hometown bullies, revealing the main creative staff and initial artwork.

item.title: 'Pen to Wappa to Jijitsukon' Unveils Additional Cast, Staff, Theme Songs, First Promo
item.description: The anime adaptation of "A Pen, Handcuffs, and a Common-Law Marriage" has revealed its additional cast members, staff, theme songs, and first promotional video alongside a new key visual.

item.title: Korea Manhwa Contents Agency Represents Korea, Guest of Honor, at France’s International Webtoon Meeting - 파이낸셜뉴스
item.description: Korea's manhwa agency participated as guest of honor at an international webtoon gathering in France, representing the country's digital comics industry.

item.title: Sennheiser exclusively sponsors G-STAR 2026 Cosplay Awards - 게임메카
item.description: German audio brand Sennheiser has secured exclusive sponsorship rights for the cosplay awards at G-STAR 2026, South Korea's major gaming and entertainment event.

item.title: Pokémon Joins Duolingo for 'Duo's Pokémon Party' Event
item.description: Duolingo has partnered with Pokémon for a collaborative event called Duo's Pokémon Party, offering users the chance to engage with the franchise while using the language-learning platform.

item.title: Wolverine and Han Solo Team-Up in Marvel's Official February 2027 Solicitations
item.description: Marvel's February 2027 solicitations reveal a crossover event pairing Wolverine with Han Solo in its second installment, blending Marvel characters with the Star Wars universe.
